intro.text: Real writing is full of punctuation. These sentences mix everything you have learnt so far.
intro.tip: Slow down a little around punctuation – it is where most mistakes happen.

steps.title: Conversation
text: "Where are you going?" asked Lena. "To the library," said Jack. "I need a book about space!"
"Is it raining?" asked Mum. "Yes - bring an umbrella!" said Dad. "Don't forget your boots."

steps.title: Notes and lists
text: Shopping list: bread, milk (semi-skimmed), apples and cheese. Don't forget the eggs!
Reminder: the school trip (to the castle) is on Friday. Bring a packed lunch - and a coat!
steps.instructions: Colons, brackets and hyphens in real notes.
